questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: It was a way for me to challenge myself by living abroad and taking subjects in my second language. Furthermore, it was important to me to explore different cultures.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: It was overall the best experience

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: I think the system in which we were to upload transcripts and find information was a little confusing and a lot of work, which i think could be optimised in the future.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: we had contact with our own university in both countries, and some information on how to get help if you had any questions

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: i think it was very difficult, do to the large demand on housing in australia i general. The pricing of accommodations was also expensive.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: That it could probably save future students money due to the high costs of living on campus, however it is also a lot of work to find housing yourself.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: I think the registrations process was very confusing with very outdated websites. It was a lot of work to register ad i think the whole proces could be optimised in the future.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: I have a hard time remembering the whole proces, but i just remember that it was very intricate.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Fortunately, we had help from teachers.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: i was very succesful and was accepted on the first try

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: I would prioritise to start with the registration in good time, and have patience.

questions.answer: always a good way in, to engage in social events at the university

questions.answer: the people is very loving and open minded.

questions.answer:
be openminded 
save up 
and be spontaneous

questions.answer: to get to be apart of another culture
